fact: Agence Ecofin reports that Niger inaugurated a new Internet Exchange Point in Niamey on 19 August 2025, opened by the Minister of Communication and New Information Technologies, as a place where ISPs interconnect directly to exchange traffic locally; no member count is given.
source_slug: 2025-08-21 Niger inaugurates a new Internet Exchange Point (IXP)

fact: ANP, citing the Smart Villages project (PVI), reports that the project achieved the creation of Niger's first Internet Exchange Point with the operator Niger Telecoms, improving the resilience of data exchange and the quality of internet traffic; the article gives no launch date or member count, so the date is the article's own (15 April 2026).
